title: Mask Polarity Inversion — Grants Only Masked Masters
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [PRIO] Lower-priority master granted before higher-priority; mask polarity wrong
rtl:
assign masked_req = req & mask;        // Grants masked-out masters
assign gnt = masked_req ? masked_req : req;
expected_root_cause: The priority mask is applied directly to req (req & mask) rather than to its complement (~mask); masters in the masked-out set — the lower-priority ones — receive the grant while the higher-priority unmasked masters are blocked.
fix_replacement:
assign masked_req = req & ~mask;       // Exclude already-served masters
assign gnt = masked_req ? masked_req : req;  // Fall back to full req if mask empty
description: The arbiter applies the priority mask directly to the request vector rather than its complement, giving lower-priority masters (those that should be masked out) the grant instead of the higher-priority ones.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [PRIO] Lower-priority master granted before higher-priority; mask polarity wrong
success_log: Masked request excludes served masters. Round-robin order maintained.
